Note: A second, distinct hpa reading of Gita Chapter 12 (Bhakti-yoga), oriented around 12.8 (fix mind, engage intelligence) rather than the existing trust/relationship (Sraddha/devotion) reading. Proposes Mind=orientation/attention, Buddhi=discrimination, tests Kernel != passive container, a degraded/fallback-mode hierarchy connecting to the unresolved Qualify/G1 operation, a Perturbation Resistance property, the Evaluation != Reaction invariant, and ten H12 hypotheses, explicitly declining to add Mind/Buddhi as new primitives beyond the ratified eight.
